snippet.title: Edgefield Trailer
snippet.description:
Edgefield is a mix of the adult visual novel, dating sim and point-and-click adventure genres with a wide and colorful cast of characters to meet, befriend, and romance (in fully animated scenes) as you make your way through your freshman year at Edgefield University. Whether you choose to play as a male or female protagonist, you’ll have the freedom to pursue relationships with characters of any gender, with a goal of making this a deeply personal and inclusive experience.

This game is free for anyone (over the age of 18) to download and enjoy, but as a patron, you'll receive exclusive perks! Patrons get early access to new updates before anyone else, along with unique rewards that vary by subscription tier.

Your contributions help bring this story to life and ensure that we can continue creating and improving the game for everyone.

Please join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/NykwRd4MWm
Follow us on Twitter - https://twitter.com/edgefieldgame
and on Itch https://undercoverpopgames.itch.io/edgefield
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629970/Edgefield/

Thank you.
- Gopher & Dr. Bird
